description: Survey logistic regression coefficients for 'killed_or_serious' (CRSS motorcycle operators and passengers). Coefficients are log-odds ratios conditional on all other terms; only the standardised margins are interpreted.  other_vehicle_body is 'none_or_multi' exactly when the crash did not have two vehicles, so in model B its coefficients and those of n_vehicles are not separately identified (the ridge resolves the split; margins are unaffected).
method: Survey-weighted logistic regression (pseudo-ML, ridge 0.01), Taylor-linearised variance (25 strata, 67 PSUs, t with 42 df); standardised predictive margins -> adjusted RR/RD. Model A = person covariates + PRE_CRASH; model B = A + crash type + number of vehicles. Flags: suppressed = n<30 or no events (event-free levels blanked); unstable = crude rate, level margin or reference margin RSE>30%.
